👁️ YOU WOKE UP IN A PRISON. YOU ARE NOT ALONE.

Five souls are trapped. The keys are hidden. And the Jailer is still hunting.

🔑 FIND THE KEYS — Search the rooms and unlock the cages.
👻 FREE FIVE SOULS — Break their chains to open the escape gate.
🏃 SURVIVE THE CHASE — Take refuge, stay alert, and never assume you’re safe.
🚪 ESCAPE TOGETHER — Reaching the gate doesn’t mean your friends have made it.

🕯️ Bring your lantern into the darkness. Find scarce supplies and use distractions to slip past the monsters.

👥 Create a party with friends.
⚙️ Choose your difficulty and face up to 3 monsters.
⛓️ Survive changing stages filled with supernatural threats and deadly traps.

The Jailer watches. The Listener hears.
Will your whole party make it out?

🎧 Headphones recommended.

10768423982.name: Lotería!

📢 Cards are called one by one

10775855304.name: Draw Your Pet 🎨
10775855304.description:
🎨 DRAW YOUR ANIMALS! 🐉
Draw ANY animal and watch it come to life on your farm!

✏️ DRAW – Your drawing becomes a real animal that earns you cash. Every drawing gets a random rarity and size, from Common all the way to SECRET!
🏡 FARM – Collect cash, upgrade your farm and buy more land, all the way up to the upstairs plots!
📦 CRATES – Open themed crates for rare animals. Some are INSANELY HUGE!
🌀 THE WILDLANDS – Take 3 animals through 9 biomes, fight scary monsters and bosses, and catch wild animals. Can you beat the Dragon King?
🌦️ EVENTS – Weather and night-time mutations, money bags that fall from the sky, animal races and drawing contests!
👫 FRIENDS – Play with a friend for 1.5x CASH! Invite friends to get a FREE Friend Dragon!
⭐ Level up, finish quests, collect daily rewards and fill your Index!

🎟️ CODES: RELEASE • DRAW • FARM
👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite for updates!
